$comment: Provenance for the third-party skills vendored into .claude/skills/ (ADR-0200).
Pinned by commit, not by branch: a skill that changes under us changes how every
session behaves, so an update is a reviewed commit like any other.
`skills` is an allowlist of UPSTREAM directory names — curation is the point, so a
skill that is not listed is not taken. `excluded` records what was refused and why;
a sync reports any upstream skill in neither list, so a --bump surfaces new
candidates instead of silently adopting or silently dropping them.
Run `node .claude/vendor/sync-skills.mjs` to re-materialise exactly this state.

excluded.git-workflow-and-versioning: Prescribes trunk-based development, its own branch naming, and a semver/changelog release flow. This repo decided branch-per-task and Conventional Commits, and has no versioning scheme.
excluded.documentation-and-adrs: Ships its own ADR template and threshold. Ours is decided and stricter — root CLAUDE.md's 'write only what a future reader would otherwise get wrong', and amend in place.
excluded.using-agent-skills: A meta-router whose decision tree points at the three skills above; with them gone it routes to absent skills.

rewrites.why: Its TDD skill is renamed to clear the collision with superpowers'; the sibling skills that route to it by name have to follow.
git-workflow-and-versioning is excluded; commit guidance here is the repo's own.

excluded.using-superpowers: Demands a skill be invoked 'before ANY response including clarifying questions' and that the model 'does not have a choice'. That is the opposite of this repo's context-engineering rule — load the minimum for the change in front of you.
excluded.using-git-worktrees: Sets up worktree isolation as a precondition. Our sessions are already isolated by branch-per-task, and `.claude/worktrees/` is gitignored scratch.
excluded.finishing-a-development-branch: Offers 'merge back to <base> locally' as an option. Root CLAUDE.md forbids committing onto local main, and a finished task ends in a pull request.

rewrites.why: finishing-a-development-branch is excluded, and three kept skills call it a REQUIRED SUB-SKILL. Point them at the convention that actually ends a task here.

sourcesRefused.$comment: Asked for, cloned, measured, and not taken. Recorded so the question is not reopened from memory — see ADR-0200.
sourcesRefused.https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-u: 7 skills, 69k+ lines, 11 MB — a palette, type scale and font/icon corpus (5.5 MB of TTFs, an 824 KB icon index) that exists to decide what a UI looks like. That is decided here by docs/design/design-language.md and ADR-0028, and drawn by the design-mockups skill.
sourcesRefused.https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable: 1 skill, 72k lines, 3.5 MB — mostly bundled browser JS for its own anti-pattern detector. The detector is the good part; without its 3 MB of scripts the skill is only a competing design language, and with them it is the single largest thing in the repo.
